name: City Builder - Datapolis Star Schema
description: 🏙️ Become the Mayor of Datapolis! Design Fabric Warehouse tables and a Power BI semantic model district by district. Master star schema, surrogate keys, SCD, and galaxy schema to graduate as Chief Data Architect.
learning_objectives: Identify facts vs dimensions and choose the right grain
Design surrogate keys and conformed dimensions
Apply SCD Type 1 and Type 2 patterns
Build star vs snowflake vs galaxy schemas
Author DAX measures on a Direct Lake / Import semantic model

items.name: Datapolis_LH
items.description: Raw 'dirty' datasets per district + expected oracle results for validation

items.name: Datapolis_DW
items.description: Empty warehouse — player creates Fact* and Dim* tables here via T-SQL

items.name: Datapolis_Model
items.description: Direct Lake semantic model bound to Datapolis_DW — player adds relationships + DAX measures in Fabric UI

items.name: Datapolis_EH
items.description: Mayor's telemetry: districts built, measures validated, reputation

items.name: CityBuilder_Seed
items.description: Generates 8 raw + expected datasets in Datapolis_LH (run once)

items.name: CityBuilder_Mayor
items.description: Briefings + mayor.inspect_district(name) validator (INFORMATION_SCHEMA + DAX via XMLA)

items.name: CityBuilder_Dashboard
items.description: City map + reputation + DAX measure scoreboard

eventTypes.name: CityCertified
eventTypes.description: Galaxy boss completed — Chief Data Architect

districts.name: City-wide BI
districts.concept: BOSS: Galaxy schema with 3 facts sharing conformed dims + perf tuning

validation_strategy.schema_check: Query INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES / COLUMNS / KEY_COLUMN_USAGE on Datapolis_DW
validation_strategy.measure_check: Connect via XMLA endpoint to Datapolis_Model, execute EVALUATE, compare to expected oracle values
validation_strategy.telemetry: Emit DistrictBuilt / DistrictRejected events to CityEvents

post_deploy_steps: Run CityBuilder_Seed notebook once to populate raw + expected datasets in Datapolis_LH
Open CityBuilder_Mayor notebook and read the District 1 briefing
Open Datapolis_DW in Fabric and CREATE the tables required by the briefing
Open Datapolis_Model in Fabric, add relationships, write DAX measures
Advance through 8 districts, ending with the City-wide BI boss (galaxy schema)
